# Cover brief: The Soother That Fell Into Dragon Land

A small girl in a yellow raincoat and red boots stands on a squishy green hilltop, holding a round blue soother up to a green sky. Beside her a tiny orange dragon with a brown satchel bounces happily, and far behind them a bubble-gum volcano blows pink and blue bubbles over a lake of warm yellow custard. Soft, rounded shapes and warm pastel colours; the mood is cozy, giggly and safe.

The template cover is drawn from `templates/cover.html`. This brief is for the image milestone (ComfyUI).
